policy: Only pages with facts that can change on a known regulatory, policy, pricing or filing cycle belong in this register. Evergreen pages are intentionally excluded.

entries.fact: Dated government, regulator, tax, pension, rate or filing-status update
entries.primarySource: Primary source listed on each FinancialUpdate record
entries.reviewTrigger: New notice, circular, notification, policy meeting, rate reset or superseding official update
entries.notes: Historical updates remain useful but must clearly distinguish the dated event from current status.

entries.fact: Current PPF, SSY, SCSS and Post Office MIS interest rates
entries.primarySource: Department of Economic Affairs small-savings notification and India Post savings pages
entries.reviewTrigger: Quarterly small-savings rate notification; mandatory review before 1 Jan, 1 Apr, 1 Jul and 1 Oct
entries.notes: Jul-Sep 2026 quarter remains the current quarter; do not imply the rate is guaranteed for the full tenure.

entries.fact: 8th CPC process status, fitment-factor status and implementation-status wording
entries.reviewTrigger: Commission recommendation, report, fitment factor, pay matrix, Government decision or implementation order
entries.notes: Official site currently lists consultation/appointment activity, including Chandigarh 16-18 Sep and Bengaluru 7-8 Oct; no final fitment factor is treated as notified.

entries.fact: Scenario labels and disclaimer that fitment factors are illustrative rather than notified pay revisions
entries.reviewTrigger: Commission recommendation, report, fitment factor, pay matrix or Government implementation order

entries.fact: AY 2026-27 filing availability, due-date status and late/revised-return guidance
entries.reviewTrigger: CBDT section 119 order/circular, e-filing utility update or filing-deadline announcement
entries.notes: Official portal was rechecked on 5 Sep 2026. ITR-2 utilities are available, but no primary-source AY 2026-27 circular establishing a different non-audit due date was located; page should continue to state statutory baseline plus verify-current-status guidance rather than invent an extension.

entries.fact: Recurring statutory tax dates and explicit commonly-extended status
entries.reviewTrigger: CBDT circular/order, Budget/Finance Act change, or a statutory deadline amendment

entries.fact: Supported financial-year slabs, rebate limits, standard deduction and cess
entries.primarySource: Income Tax Department and enacted Finance Act for the supported year
entries.reviewTrigger: Finance Act, Budget tax change, CBDT clarification affecting calculator scope, or new supported financial year
entries.notes: Formula changes require a separate cited correctness change and regression tests.

entries.fact: Zerodha, Upstox and Angel One brokerage, account-opening and demat AMC claims
entries.primarySource: Official Zerodha, Upstox and Angel One pricing/support pages
entries.reviewTrigger: Broker pricing announcement, fee-table change, product/account eligibility change
entries.notes: Commercial relationships never determine ranking or factual conclusions.

entries.fact: RBI policy-rate context and regulated lending-rule references
entries.reviewTrigger: MPC policy decision, RBI circular/direction or effective-date change

entries.fact: EPFO scheme, contribution, withdrawal and compliance-rule claims
entries.primarySource: EPFO / Ministry of Labour and Employment
entries.reviewTrigger: EPFO circular, Ministry notification, interest-rate declaration or scheme amendment

entries.fact: Gratuity eligibility, wage-definition and labour-code implementation wording
entries.primarySource: Ministry of Labour and Employment / PIB / enacted labour codes and notified rules
entries.reviewTrigger: Central/state commencement notification, rules notification or Ministry clarification

entries.fact: NPS withdrawal/annuity/tax-rule and scheme claims
entries.primarySource: PFRDA and Income Tax Department where tax treatment is stated
entries.reviewTrigger: PFRDA circular/regulation or tax-law change

entries.fact: Central-government DA/DR and pension-policy update claims
entries.primarySource: Department of Expenditure / Department of Pension and Pensioners' Welfare / PIB
entries.reviewTrigger: Cabinet decision, Department of Expenditure order, pension OM or half-yearly DA/DR revision

entries.fact: Live/reference gold-price timestamps and data-provider status
entries.primarySource: Configured gold-rate provider plus RBI only for lending rules
entries.reviewTrigger: Provider failure, stale quote timestamp, methodology/provider change
entries.notes: A user-entered illustrative gold price must never be described as today's market price.

entries.fact: Assessment-year tax-regime and HRA guidance
entries.reviewTrigger: Finance Act or filing-year guidance changes
entries.notes: The example uses assumed TDS; verify tax treatment before any rule-based sample.

entries.fact: RBI KFS, APR and credit-card repayment disclosures
entries.reviewTrigger: New RBI lending or credit card circular and FAQs
entries.notes: Examples use hypothetical rates and fees; lender terms control actual cost.

entries.fact: PPF scheme tenure and the periodically notified small-savings rates
entries.reviewTrigger: Quarterly rate reset or amendment to scheme terms
entries.notes: No current rate is hard-coded into guide examples.

entries.fact: EPFO contribution allocation and notified interest
entries.reviewTrigger: EPFO circular or annual interest-rate notification
entries.notes: The contribution-only example excludes interest and employer EPS allocation.

entries.fact: Official HSN/SAC rate lookup and GST classification
entries.reviewTrigger: GST Council or CBIC notification altering rate or classification
entries.notes: Illustrative 18% is not attributed to a specific product or service.

entries.fact: Labour-code gratuity rules, wage basis and eligibility exceptions
entries.reviewTrigger: Ministry of Labour notification, rule clarification or ceiling change
entries.notes: Worked example must stay explicitly conditional on eligible wages and service.

entries.fact: State-specific registration and stamp charges
entries.reviewTrigger: State fee amendment or official calculator revision
entries.notes: West Bengal source is an example; no nationwide duty rate is claimed.
